test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘FLED' is coded as '4, 10, 3, 2', ‘GOAT' is coded as '5, 13, 25, 18'. What is the code for ‘HECK' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

Logic: Place value of Opposite letter - 2 = Code of thar letter.

Now,

'FLED' is coded as '4, 10, 3, 2'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b519edd26067442fa78bfefa5def98f639897068a6637b8862159f99fcb82335.png] 

'GOAT' is coded as '5, 13, 25, 18'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc80af0c483771302a608b8c7f08899ce070a60521e337be57c9a307a8d1e545.png] 

Similarly, for '**HECK**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3b2b69b67b8e7dafef005c570feada67a91defc50214784b7883b0cea48890b.png] 

So, 'HECK' will be coded as '**6, 3, 1, 9**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
